name: free_busy
description: Return busy time blocks across all event calendars for a date/time range. Returns {"busy": [{"start", "end"}]} where start/end are ISO 8601 datetimes with an offset in the configured default timezone, merged and clipped to the range. No event details (summary, UID, attendees, calendar, etc.) are returned.

start.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime for the start of the range. Date-only values mean local midnight; offset-less datetimes are read in the configured default timezone (UTC if unset).

end.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime for the end of the range (exclusive). Date-only values cover the whole day, up to the next local midnight; offset-less datetimes are read in the configured default timezone (UTC if unset). The range must be positive and at most 31 days.
